package records

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/viant/datly/application"
	mcpserver "github.com/viant/datly/mcp/server"
	"github.com/viant/jsonrpc"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	"github.com/viant/mcp/client"
)

type exposurePublic struct {
	manager  *application.Manager
	ctx      context.Context
	native   *client.Client
	registry bool
	fixed    bool
}

func (c exposurePublic) check(t *testing.T, selection exposureSelection, id int) {
	t.Helper()
	if c.native != nil || c.registry {
		c.catalog(t, selection)
	}
	for _, endpoint := range []struct {
		path, tool string
		exposed    bool
	}{{"/records", "records.public", selection.app}, {"/internal-records", "records.lookup", selection.private}} {
		for _, tenant := range []int{7, 8} {
			var body []byte
			if c.native == nil && !c.registry {
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				c.manager.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", fmt.Sprintf("%s?tenant=%d", endpoint.path, tenant), nil).WithContext(c.ctx))
				status := 404
				if endpoint.exposed {
					status = 200
				}
				if response.Code != status {
					t.Fatalf("%s HTTP %d: %s", endpoint.path, response.Code, response.Body.String())
				}
				if !endpoint.exposed {
					continue
				}
				body = response.Body.Bytes()
			} else {
				result, err := c.call(&schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: endpoint.tool, Arguments: map[string]any{"tenant": tenant}})
				if !endpoint.exposed {
					var rpcErr *jsonrpc.Error
					if !errors.As(err, &rpcErr) || rpcErr.Code != jsonrpc.MethodNotFound || result != nil {
						t.Fatalf("hidden %s result=%+v error=%v", endpoint.tool, result, err)
					}
					continue
				}
				if err != nil || result == nil || result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError {
					t.Fatalf("%s result=%+v error=%v", endpoint.tool, result, err)
				}
				body, err = json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			var actual any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &actual); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var want any
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"Status":"","Data":[{"Id":%d}]}`, id+10*(tenant-7))), &want); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, want) {
				t.Fatalf("%s output=%s want=%v", endpoint.path, body, want)
			}
		}
	}
}

func (c exposurePublic) catalog(t *testing.T, selection exposureSelection) {
	t.Helper()
	listed, err := c.list()
	if !selection.app && !selection.private && c.native != nil && c.fixed {
		var rpcErr *jsonrpc.Error
		if !errors.As(err, &rpcErr) || rpcErr.Code != jsonrpc.MethodNotFound || listed != nil {
			t.Fatalf("empty tools: %+v %v", listed, err)
		}
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{}
	if selection.app {
		want = append(want, "records.public")
	}
	if selection.private {
		want = append(want, "records.lookup")
	}
	sort.Strings(want)
	got := []string{}
	for _, tool := range listed.Tools {
		got = append(got, tool.Name)
		input := tool.InputSchema
		// Native decoding represents absent extension fields by an empty map.
		if extension, ok := input.AdditionalProperties.(map[string]any); ok && len(extension) == 0 {
			input.AdditionalProperties = nil
		}
		expected := schema.ToolInputSchema{Type: "object", Required: []string{"tenant"}, Properties: map[string]map[string]any{"tenant": {"type": "integer"}}}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("%s business schema=%+v", tool.Name, tool.InputSchema)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(got)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("tools/list=%v want=%v", got, want)
	}
}

// Registry mode is separately named evidence, never a fallback for wire denial.
func (c exposurePublic) list() (*schema.ListToolsResult, error) {
	if c.native != nil {
		return c.native.ListTools(c.ctx, nil)
	}
	_, service, err := c.manager.Pin(c.ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &schema.ListToolsResult{Tools: service.Registry().ListRegisteredTools()}, nil
}
func (c exposurePublic) call(params *schema.CallToolRequestParams) (*schema.CallToolResult, error) {
	if c.native != nil {
		return c.native.CallTool(c.ctx, params)
	}
	ctx, service, err := c.manager.Pin(c.ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	factory, err := mcpserver.NewHandler(service)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	handler, err := factory(ctx, nil, nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result, rpcErr := handler.CallTool(ctx, &jsonrpc.TypedRequest[*schema.CallToolRequest]{Request: &schema.CallToolRequest{Method: schema.MethodToolsCall, Params: *params}})
	if rpcErr != nil {
		return result, rpcErr
	}
	return result, nil
}
